summary: The pattern addresses a real comprehension bottleneck, provided the companion is treated as a selective, evidence-linked product rather than a prettier copy of the repository.

points.text: The smallest useful implementation may be generated static HTML. Interactivity, graph navigation and a large canvas should be added only when concrete comprehension tasks require them.
A companion earns trust through provenance, explicit current-versus-target semantics and visible freshness, not through visual polish.
The pattern generalizes wiki-as-cognitive-interface; it should reuse that pattern's layered pages, decision history and task links rather than duplicate them under a new name.
Living Documentation already establishes continuous investment in knowledge and automation. AI changes the urgency and feasible interaction model, not the underlying need.
